text:
Asha: Quick sync 1: we need the final email plan for the benchmark webinar (next Thu). goal = live regs + post-event blog reads + demo requests. who owns what?
Liam: Proposed cadence: 3-touch microdrip: 1) invite (low friction reg CTA) 2) reminder + highlights (social proof + agenda) 3) day-of + watch-live CTA. + a post-event followup with blog + replay.
Priya: Segment strategy: split by role and company tier. small (<=50 employees) -> product-first messaging; mid-market -> ROI + quick win; enterprise/dedicated -> SLA + security callout.
Asha: We need explicit segment queries so DF can pull lists. Priya, can you paste SQL for the three segments?
Priya: Sure. infra/platform segment:
```
SELECT email FROM users
WHERE role IN ('platform','infra','sre')
  AND company_size >= 100
  AND last_active > now() - interval '365 days'
  AND unsubscribed = false
  AND trial_opt_out = false;
```
product/startup segment:
```
SELECT email FROM users
WHERE role = 'product'
  AND company_size < 50
  AND last_engagement > now() - interval '180 days'
  AND email_verified = true
  AND unsubscribed = false;
```
enterprise/dedicated lane:
```
SELECT email FROM users
WHERE dedicated_customer = true
  AND account_health = 'good'
  AND ae_assigned IS NOT NULL
  AND unsubscribed = false;
```
Liam: Nice. For counts we expect ~9k infra, ~16k product/startup, ~800 dedicated. Priya can you add exclusion list for previous webinar no-shows who marked no-email?
Priya: Will add suppression: exclude previous_webinar.no_shows_opted_out and partner_contacts.
Carlos: Deliverability notes: use a 3-step ramp (10% -> 30% -> 100%) over 24 hours to avoid a sender-reputation hit. add seed list of 120 addresses (inbox preview + mailbox provider monitors). set custom return-path and SPF/DKIM validated on staging.
Asha: Subject & preheader variants: we will A/B subject lines across infra vs product. Examples:
- infra variant: "Benchmark: 2.8x throughput, 35% lower inference cost"
- product variant: "How inference improvements speed up your UX"
Preheader A/B: "Join live + get the full benchmark deck" vs "See real numbers from production workloads"
Liam: Test matrix: subject A vs B, CTA dest A (direct reg) vs B (blog + reg). We'll run subject A/B within each segment and CTA as a secondary split (1-1/2 of users). Track opens, clicks->reg conversion, and downstream demo requests.
Asha: UTM rules?
Priya: Use utm_campaign=benchmark_q2, utm_source=newsletter, utm_medium=email, utm_content={segment}_{variant}. Add event tags: nl_open, nl_click, nl_register.
Carlos: QA checklist: inbox render (Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, iOS), seed opens, link checks, button fallback for text-only clients, accessibility alt text for images. Send final assets to deliverability 24h before send.
Asha: Timeline: copy draft by Tue 9am (Elaine is writing), creative assets Wed EOD, DF pull Wed night, QA Thu morning, ramp send Fri NA/EMEA, APAC Mon local morning.
Liam: Sales coordination: AE brief with dedicated list + dynamic snippet "Dedicated customers: priority access" in the email for AE follow-up. Priya: add tag dedicated_followup=true for that segment.
Priya: Also building a small nurture drip for registrants: immediate confirmation, 48h follow-up with highlights, 1-hour reminder. We'll feed all registrants into lead scoring pipeline.
Asha: Convert to the newsletter brief and attach to the growth board. please paste final segment counts in this thread once DF runs.
PreviewBot: staging preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/newsletters/1765513379. Render passed mobile/desktop for seeded clients.
Carlos: Reminder: mute throttles if spam complaints > 0.05% in first wave.
Liam: I'll set the experiment in the ESP and share the tracking doc.
Asha: Thanks team, locking plan. :rocket:
